content:
{'0': 'Apple has officially announced the date of its September event, with the tagline "Surprise and shine," which is adapted from the English idiom "rise and shine." The company is expected to unveil its first-ever foldable iPhone at the event.'}

{'1': 'Meanwhile, the localized tagline on its Chinese website hides an easter egg that appears to be a play on "foldable," at least according to Google Translate.'}

{'2': 'Before the official "Surprise and shine" tagline was released, Apple fans eagerly anticipating the first iPhone with a folding screen had speculated about various event taglines, many of which featured playful puns on the word "unfold."'}

{'3': "In China, Google Translate at least considers the English version to mean almost exactly the same thing as the fans' guesses."}

{'4': 'If you screenshot the event image from Apple\'s China website and run it through Google image translation, you get the following machine-translated result: "A new chapter unfolds, dazzling and radiant."'}

{'5': 'Results vary with other translation tools, but this is at least a fun little easter egg as we count down to the big unveiling two weeks from now.'}

{'6': 'Get the most out of your Apple products'}
